summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Franz Josef Popp, born in Vienna in 1886 and died in Stuttgart in 1954. It states that he was one of three men responsible for founding BMW AG and served as its First General Director from 1922 to 1942.
one_line: Franz Josef Popp was an Austrian-born figure who co-founded BMW AG and led it as First General Director from 1922 to 1942.
key_facts: Franz Josef Popp was born on 14 January 1886 in Vienna.
Franz Josef Popp died on 29 July 1954 in Stuttgart.
Franz Josef Popp was one of three men responsible for the founding of BMW AG.
Franz Josef Popp served as First General Director of BMW AG from 1922 to 1942.
